props.name: value
props.description: The formatted amount without its sign — "1,250.00". If your formatter already wrote the sign, leave `sign` unset.

props.name: currency
props.description: A currency or unit label shown with the value, exactly as given — "SAR", "USD", "€", "%", "kWh".

props.name: currencyPosition
props.description: Where the label sits relative to the value, in reading order. Default "before" ("SAR 1,250.00").

props.name: sign
props.description: Writes a sign before the amount, plus a spoken word for it. Default: none.

props.name: tone
props.description: Colour reinforcement. Independent of `sign`; never the only signal. Default "neutral".

props.name: size
props.description: `compact` inside lists and tables; `standard` (default) where the amount is the point.

props.name: accessibleLabel
props.description: What assistive technology hears instead of the visible text — "minus 25 Saudi riyals".

props.name: signLabels
props.description: The spoken words for the sign glyphs. Defaults: { positive: "plus", negative: "minus" }.
